newsitem.title: THAILAND: India bites into Thai rice markets.
newsitem.headline: India bites into Thai rice markets.

text.p: India is emerging as a strong competitior to Thailand in lower grade rice export markets, the president of the Thai Rice Exporters' Association said.
Vorapong Pichpongsa told Reuters over the weekend that some of Thailand's parboiled rice market share had now been taken over by India.
"We used to export around 800,000 to 900,000 tonnes of parboiled rice a year. Now the exports of such a grade have dropped to around 500,000 to 600,000 (tonnes) a year," he said.

India produced nearly 81 million tonnes of rice in the 1995/96 crop year ending June 30. It exported a record 5.5 million tonnes of rice that year, emerging as the second largest world exporter after Thailand, whose rice exports in 1995 topped six million tonnes.
Thailand expects to export about 5.2 million tonnes this year.
Some market sources here said rice from India was biting into Thailand's market share in Africa and the Middle East.
However, Vorapong said he was still bullish about the prospects for Thai rice exports, adding the country should continue to develop the quality of its rice and hold on to its high grade markets.
"There's no reason to be worried. The prospect for Thai high quality rice such as fragrant or 100 percent grade remains good," Vorapong said.
"Although the United States is our competitor in the high quality rice market, our prices are still cheaper. Therefore, Thai farmers should continue to develop the quality of rice," he said.
Hong Kong last week signed a memorandum of understanding with Thai exporters to buy 270,000 tonnes of high quality rice in 1997.
Vorapong added that a current slowdown in foreign buying orders for Thai rice should not be seen as a sign that Thai rice had lost its competitive edge.
"It's the end of the season, so prices are a bit high. I think buyers are just waiting for fresh (new crop) supplies to enter the market in November and December before placing new orders," he said.
According to the commerce ministry's data, Thailand's rice exports during the first nine months of this year have already exceeded four million tonnes.
